_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Done: Find companies like one company

description: Find companies similar to one company, given its domain (such as stripe.com) or name: operating companies in Wikidata that share its industries (or, when it has none, its business type), in its own country unless you send another country or any, ranked by how many industries they share, then by how close their head count is to its own (size_gap, in powers of ten), then by how well known they are. Each row has shared_industries, size_gap, website, head count, LEI and the GLEIF legal entity; company shows what was matched on. Coverage follows Wikidata, so small firms are often missing. No person is named. Costs 1 credit. Every row has name (platform/collection/id), kind, its fields and source {platform, url, license, attribution, fetched_at, terms_url}; quote source.attribution when you show a row.

country.description: Optional: a two-letter ISO code or English country name to search in, or any for every country (default: the company's own country).

domain.description: The company's domain, such as stripe.com (a URL also works).

name.description: The company's name, such as Stripe; used when no domain is sent.

name: data_company_lookalikes
title: Find companies like one company
